messages:
maya: FYI multiple customers reporting 502/504s and timeouts hitting /v1/generate since ~08:20 UTC. spike in Hosted API 5xx
liam: seeing same in SLO dashboard, p50->p95 latency jump, error-rate ~6% for the last 10m :grimacing:
sophia: any obvious deploys or config flips?
oliver: no deploys in the window, CI shows green. autoscaler logs show a few instance restarts for hostpool-us-west-2
oncall-bot: Incident opened: hosted-inference-5xx-1760012345 (severity P1)
maya: tagged support, eng-runtime, eng-sre. @jen can you collect customer repro steps and top traces?
jen: on it. initial support notes: customer A and B both see streaming timeouts, customer C gets intermittent 502s. raising a cust-escalation ticket.
liam: attaching quick logs from gateway: ```ERROR proxy.go:237 upstream response 502: timeout reading from backend; conn_id=7894```
sophia: KV cache miss rate spiked around same time, could be causing slowdowns and timeouts on inference backend
maya: temp mitigation idea: enable model-variant fallback for heavy routes and route 10% traffic to smaller quantized instance. Thoughts?
oliver: good. also widen circuit breaker to avoid thundering retries from clients for 30m. set backoff to exp(1.5)
jen: I can push fallback toggle via /admin/routes/route-id -> set fallback=true. Will coordinate with SRE before flip.
liam: start with a small canary 5% and monitor errors for 5m then 20% if stable
sophia: check KMS and auth proxies too — I saw auth proxy 504s in same timeframe which may be compounding client retries
maya: support-bot, post a canned message to impacted customers: "we see degraded response times; working on mitigation; ETA 30–60m"
support-bot: Posted to affected customers and created support ticket threads.
jen: repro checklist: capture full request id header, sample client body, and trace ids. here's a quick curl we asked customers to run: ```curl -H 'x-request-id: <id>' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -v```
oliver: rolling the fallback now — canary 5% -> monitoring. alert if 5xx > 1%
liam: after 4m canary looks good, error-rate down to 1.1% on canary path, global still ~3%
sophia: increasing to 25% to relieve pressure on main backend. watch kv-cache miss rate and GPU queue depth
maya: observing GPU queue depth drop and 5xx trend downward. good. please document exact toggles for postmortem.
jen: documenting changes: toggled route-id X fallback=true (5% -> 25%), increased circuit breaker threshold from 50->120 reqs, updated backoff multiplier.
oliver: follow-up actions: 1) validate KV cache warmup strategy for cold bursts 2) add autoscaler cooldown 3) implement client-side retry guidance 4) postmortem
maya: assigning owners: kv cache = sophia, autoscaler = liam, retry guidance = jen, postmortem = oliver
jen: customer communications updated with mitigation summary and ETA for permanent fix: 48h
oliver: saving logs and traces to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1760012345/ ; will attach to PM
maya: quick note: suspected root cause = simultaneous cache warmups causing backend queueing + circuit-breaker sensitivity causing amplified retries. need to validate with heap and latency traces
sophia: I'll audit cache ttl and warmup heuristics and propose immediate change (prewarm top N prefixes) in next 24h
liam: will propose autoscaler cooldown patch and safe-scaling threshold, aiming for canary tomorrow UTC morning
oliver: I'll own the postmortem doc and publish action items by EOD today. draft link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1760012345
maya: thanks team. keeping channel open for any regressions.
support-bot: Incident severity lowered to P2 based on mitigation effectiveness, re-open if customer impact resumes."
